[[File:Pokémon Hisuian Snow poster Japanese.png|thumb|250px|Japanese poster]] '''Pokémon: Hisuian Snow''' (Japanese: '''雪ほどきし{{tt|二藍|ふたあい}}''' ''Snowmelt Indigo'') is an {{pkmn|animation|animated}} miniseries based on [[Pokémon Legends: Arceus]] featuring an original story set in the [[Hisui]] [[region]]. It consists of three episodes. It premiered on May 18, 2022 on the official Pokémon [[YouTube]] channels and [[Pokémon TV]]. It was announced worldwide on [[Pokémon Day]] on February 27, 2022 through [[Pokémon Press Conference#2022|Pokémon Presents]]. ==Blurb== The Hisui region was originally explored in the Pokémon Legends: Arceus video game and represents the Sinnoh region of old—before the existence of Pokémon Trainers and Pokémon Leagues. “Pokémon: Hisuian Snow” is a story that takes place during this ancient age when the relationship between people and Pokémon was very different. Aboard a boat bound for the Hisui region, the protagonist Alec reminisces about the first time his father took him there. Over the span of three episodes, “Pokémon: Hisuian Snow” will go into detail about Alec’s stories from the past. ==Plot== {{incomplete plot}} ==Episodes== {{Episodelistheader|Hisui}} {{Episodelistbody|HIS01|Onto the Icy Blue|青き踏む|Spring Trek upon the Icy Blue|May 18, 2022|May 18, 2022}} {{Episodelistbody|HIS02|Fiery Reflections in Snow|名残り雪、赤く|Lingering Snow, Blushing Red|June 8, 2022|June 8, 2022}} {{Episodelistbody|HIS03|Two Hues|二藍|Indigo|June 22, 2022|June 22, 2022}} {{Episodelistfooterspecial|Hisui|This concludes Pokémon: Hisuian Snow.}} ==Cast== {{cast/h|Hisui}} {{cast|Hisui|Alec|disp=Alec|List of English voice actors{{!}}Chris Hackney|Akio|Kōki Uchiyama|アキオ|内山昂輝|top=yes}} {{cast|Hisui|Alec|disp=Alec (young)|List of English voice actors{{!}}Lizzie Freeman|Akio (young)|Rie Kugimiya|アキオ（幼少期）|釘宮理恵}} {{cast|Hisui|Alec|disp=Father|List of English voice actors{{!}}Steve Kramer|Akio's father|Rikiya Koyama|アキオの父|小山力也}} {{cast|Hisui|Cyllene|List of English voice actors{{!}}Alexandra Yastishock|Shimaboshi|Romi Park|シマボシ|朴璐美}} {{cast|Hisui|Zorua (Pokémon)|disp=Zorua|Rikako Aikawa|Zorua|Rikako Aikawa|ゾロア|愛河里花子}} {{cast|Hisui|Zoroark (Pokémon)|disp=Zoroark|Rikako Aikawa|Zoroark|Rikako Aikawa|ゾロアーク|愛河里花子}} {{cast|Hisui|Garchomp (Pokémon)|disp=Garchomp|List of Japanese voice actors{{!}}Shinnosuke Ogami|Gaburias|List of Japanese voice actors{{!}}Shinnosuke Ogami​|ガブリアス|拝真之介|bottom=yes}} |} ==Staff== {| class="credits-table roundy" style="width: 100%; background: #{{colorschemedark|Hisui}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemelight|Hisui}}" |- style="vertical-align: middle; background:#fff" ! style="{{roundytl|5px}}" width="24%" | Director
